Learned counsel for the petitioner(s) seeks permission to withdraw these special leave petitions with liberty to agitate the ground(s) with regard to applicability of the Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 before the High Court by filing of a Review Petition.
